accepted.quote: H.R. 3482, as introduced, would require the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to deploy the External Provider Scheduling (EPS) program across the Veterans Health Administration enterprise within a year of enactment. While Democratic Members support the intent of this requirement
accepted.rationale: The passage states support for the intent to require VA-wide deployment of the EPS scheduling technology.

accepted.quote: Committee Democrats support this bill with the changes made by Representative Budzinski's ANS and look forward to working with VA to improve veterans' timely access to the healthcare they are owed.
accepted.rationale: The passage states support for the amended bill as a means to improve veterans' timely access to healthcare.
